title: Franco Fernandez · AI Engineer and software development
description: Franco Fernandez, Buenos Aires. AI Engineer and software developer: AI agents, bots, automations and custom platforms with Python, JavaScript, n8n and LLMs that work in production.

hero.h1: I build AI agents, bots and automations with LLMs that work in production.
hero.lead: AI Engineer with 5+ years in operations and digital transformation. Besides automating, I develop custom software (platforms, APIs and integrations) and always start from the business problem before defining the solution.

years in operations and digital transformation

flow.title: // how my agents work · click a step or run it

steps.label: Event
steps.detail: A webhook receives the message and, if the customer sends several in a row, it waits a few seconds (debounce) to group them before processing.

steps.label: Preprocessing
steps.detail: Images are described with vision and audio is transcribed, so the agent always works with text.

steps.label: Agent
steps.text: Claude, OpenAI or DeepSeek reason and pick a tool
steps.detail: The model interprets the intent and decides which tool to use (tool use): search products, check an order, installments, etc. I use Claude, OpenAI or DeepSeek depending on the case.

steps.label: Action
steps.text: Replies, hands off or closes the sale
steps.detail: It replies to the customer, applies labels, hands off to a person when needed and can start a follow-up.

sim: event incoming message: "Do you have model X in stock?"
preprocess waits 5 s in case more messages arrive; no images or audio

p: I come from operations: I coordinated teams, audits and processes before moving on to automate them. That background helps me understand the business problem before choosing the tool.

Today I work with the Claude, OpenAI and DeepSeek APIs, with n8n and Power Automate, and with AI-assisted development in Python and JavaScript. I study Industrial Engineering at UADE. I like to launch fast with what already exists and build custom only what is needed.
I also develop software: the WhatsApp + Odoo conversational platform, custom Tienda Nube apps, API integrations and a demo CRM (FastAPI, React and PostgreSQL) with 33 tests and open source code.
now: Developing automations and AI solutions at Softtek
Building my second brain with Obsidian, MCP and Claude
Studying Industrial Engineering and a SAP diploma at UADE
